`dolby-vision-rpu.bin` 是一个 438 字节的 HEVC Dolby Vision RPU NAL 单元，仅含动态映射元数据，不含视频图像或音频。它用于验证去除转义字节后的 RPU 头和 CRC 校验，以及缺少杜比视界容器配置的 MP4 回退识别。测试在内存中生成 MP4 样本表，不依赖外部视频、ffprobe 或下载。
# Classification fixtures

`classification.ass` is synthetic text authored for this project's tests: 12 sequential bottom-center dialogue events, 12 horizontal scrolling events, and 3 distinct animation events. `classification.mkv` wraps the exact ASS using subtitle stream copy. These contain no external media; regenerate with `scripts/generate-caption-fixtures.ps1`.

`ass-fixture.ttf` is an original, minimal test font containing a square-shaped A glyph, generated by `scripts/generate-ass-font.py` (development dependency: fontTools). It contains no third-party glyphs and uses the project's MIT license. `ass-font.mkv` attaches that font to the classification subtitle fixture, testing extraction and selection of container fonts. Regenerate with the same fixture script.

`dan-any/` contains synthetic input exported by `@dan-uni/dan-any-ext-ass@2.2.3` using `@dan-uni/dan-any@2.3.9`, plus gzip/brotli and legacy Raw representations of the same records. `manifest.json` records fixture hashes and independent Base16384 vectors from `base16384@1.0.0`. Regenerate using `generate-dan-any.mjs` and the development-only installation command in that file. These fixtures intentionally preserve upstream output details, including its timestamp formatting and malformed default colour text, to test interoperability with actual files. No Node runtime or upstream core code is shipped with the product.
